mapper.select: /* CastSmltMapper.retrieveWaitPsgList */ SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24')) AS HOUR, SUM(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT) AS WAIT_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24')) ORDER BY HOUR

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltKpiRaw */ SELECT ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_WTNG_HR)) AS AVG_WTNG_HR, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.AVG_WTNG_HR)) AS P95_WTNG_HR, MAX(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT) AS MAX_WTNG_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item})
mapper.insert: /* CastSmltMapper.insertSmltFlfmtHstry */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_FLFMT_HSTRY ( SMLT_ID, SMLT_FLFMT_SN, TMNL_ID, SMLT_TYPE, SMLT_FLFMT_STTS_CD, SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{smltId}, #{smltFlfmtSn}, #{tmnlId}, #{smltType}, #{smltFlfmtSttsCd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: /* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltFlfmtList */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT DESC) AS ROW_NUM, A.SMLT_ID, A.SMLT_FLFMT_SN, A.TMNL_ID, A.SMLT_TYPE, A.SMLT_FLFMT_STTS_CD, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), '') AS SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT, NVL(ROUND((CAST(A.SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(A.SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 1440), 0) AS EXEC_MIN, A.FRST_RGTR_ID AS RGTR_ID, NVL(D.DEPT_NM, '') AS DEPT_NM, NVL(C.USER_NM, '') AS USER_NM FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_FLFMT_HSTRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_USER C ON A.FRST_RGTR_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_DEPT D ON C.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') BETWEEN #{bgnDt} AND #{endDt} ORDER BY A.SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT DESC

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltFlfmtSmry */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.SMLT_FLFMT_STTS_CD = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DONE_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.SMLT_FLFMT_STTS_CD = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RUNNING_CNT, NVL(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN A.SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CAST(A.SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(A.SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 86400 END )), 0) AS AVG_EXEC_SEC FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_FLFMT_HSTRY A WHERE 1 = 1 AND TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') BETWEEN #{bgnDt} AND #{endDt}
